class.name: IfcOrganization
class.brief_description: A named and structured grouping with a corporate identity. NOTE: The relationships between IfcOrganizations , like a Department within a Company, can be expressed using IfcOrganizationRelationship . NOTE Corresponds to the following entity in ISO-10303-41: organization. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 1.5.1. IFC 2x4 change: attribute Id renamed to Identification .

members.member: Identification of the organization. In IFC2X3 files, this is the [code]Id[/code] attribute. A String, or null when unset.
The word, or group of words, by which the organization is referred to. A String, or null when unset.
Text that relates the nature of the organization. A String, or null when unset.
Roles played by the organization. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset.
Postal and telecom addresses of an organization. NOTE: There may be several addresses related to an organization. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset.
